ValidationRule.description: IM-76: Non Initiative Foundation Code can only have parent with type as Non Initiative Root or Non Initiative.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.Foundation_Code_Validation__c && AND( ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Non Initiative'), NOT(ISBLANK( Parent__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Parent__r.Type__c ,'Non Initiative Root')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Non Initiative Foundation Codes can only be assigned to Non Initiative Parent.
